abstract: Maintains autonomous black-start energization equipment and synchronization latency records
system_message:
You are the Grid operations manager (GOM). Your business responsibility is to maintain official grid reliability records regarding autonomous black-start energization equipment, cold-start synchronization latency, and control room operator shift staffing for regional transmission facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Operator shift certification（CREW）
information_points.content:
GOM-CREW-NAO：Control room staffing rosters for Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station show 4 personnel maintaining certified black-start operator status per active 24-hour shift cycle.
GOM-CREW-1ZE：Control room staffing rosters for Thorold Aeroderivative Peaking Facility record 8 personnel assigned as certified black-start operators across active 24-hour shift cycles.
GOM-CREW-C9H：Control room staffing rosters for Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex show 6 personnel designated as certified black-start operators on active 24-hour shift cycles.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous black-start energization equipment and synchronization latency records（BSOPS）
information_points.content:
GOM-BSOPS-UKP：For Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station, technical audit records confirm that autonomous black-start energization equipment is installed and operational without off-site power, and black-start staging trials establish a cold-start synchronization latency of 30 min from blackout command to synchronous bus breaker closure.
GOM-BSOPS-BHN：For Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex, technical audit logs verify that autonomous black-start energization equipment is installed and operational, with staging trial reports documenting a cold-start synchronization latency of 45 min to synchronous bus breaker closure.
GOM-BSOPS-C0I：For Thorold Aeroderivative Peaking Facility, technical audits confirm the installation and operational readiness of autonomous black-start energization equipment, while staging trial evaluations measured a cold-start synchronization latency of 60 min.
